if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/Scripts/graphify.exe" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/Scripts/graphify.exe" hook-guard read; elif [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/bin/graphify" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/bin/graphify" hook-guard read; fi; exit 0

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/Scripts/graphify.exe" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/Scripts/graphify.exe" hook-guard compact; elif [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/bin/graphify" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/bin/graphify" hook-guard compact; fi; exit 0
